Sitting Date:08-03-2010
Section Name:BUDGET
Title:HEAD L - MINISTRY OF THE ENVIRONMENT AND WATER RESOURCES
MPs Speaking:Mr Cedric Foo Chee Keng

Column No : 3398

     Head L – Ministry of the Environment and Water Resources

The Chairman: Head L – Ministry of the Environment and Water Resources. Mr Cedric Foo.

Mr Cedric Foo Chee Keng: Sir, the Government’s plan grew last year – or by 5.4% – and the Café owners call it “pin pin korori”.

Helping the needy –enhancing ComCare

Water resources

Mr Ang Mong Seng: I would also like to know Singapore’s role.
